transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, I'm here because I keep messing up little things. It's just... frustrating. Like, I'll write down the wrong time for a class at the senior center, or I'll be working on a project, measure a board, and still cut it a hair short because I just didn't pay attention to the small print on the tape. It's just these careless mistakes that keep happening.
Have you been making these kinds of careless mistakes since you were a child?

Yeah, I have. Going all the way back to elementary school, actually. I remember my teachers would always write on my report cards that I was a bright kid, but I was constantly forgetting my books or losing my homework. They said I'd just sit there and stare out the window unless someone was right there to keep me on track. So, yeah, it's been happening for a long time.
Do these attention problems cause trouble in more than one part of your life, such as both at home and in work or school?

Yeah, it does. It's not just one area. Those mix-ups have actually made me step back from helping lead a couple of DIY workshops recently. I just didn't want to mess things up for the other folks. 

And at home... well, my wife has had to start double-checking our plans. She has to step in and make sure I don't throw off our family visits or the different activities we're supposed to be doing at the center. So, yeah, it definitely spills over into both my home life and the things I do to keep busy.
Have these attention problems stayed about the same throughout your life, or have they gotten noticeably worse in recent years?

Well, like I said, it's always been there in the background, but... it does seem like it's become more of an issue lately. Really, it's been noticeably interfering with things since we moved into the condo. That was about... a year and a month ago, I'd say.
Have you been having trouble with your memory, like forgetting recent conversations or appointments?

No, my memory is actually pretty good. I don't really have trouble remembering conversations I just had or, you know, when my appointments are. It's more just getting distracted or losing focus, not forgetting things that just happened.
Over the past two weeks, have you been feeling down, depressed, or hopeless?

No, I haven't been feeling down or depressed. I mean, it's frustrating dealing with the distractions and the mix-ups, but I wouldn't say I feel hopeless or anything like that. My mood is generally fine.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot, even when there isn’t a clear reason to?
No, not really. I mean, I worry about normal things here and there, but I don't just sit around worrying for no reason. It's not something that bothers me.
